name: Can you remove a pool in winter or during rainy weather?

mainEntity.name: Is there a best season for pool demolition in Los Angeles, and does weather affect compaction?
mainEntity.text: Is there a best season for pool demolition in Los Angeles, and does weather affect compaction?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Los Angeles, pool removal is possible in most seasons because the climate is relatively mild. Still, dry weather usually makes the job easier and more predictable. Wet soil is harder to excavate cleanly, compaction can be less reliable, and access routes may get muddy or damaged. Rain can also delay inspections or require the contractor to pause work until conditions improve. That is why many homeowners prefer to schedule demolition during a dry stretch, especially if the project includes major backfill and grading. If the yard needs to be finished quickly for landscaping or a follow-on build, weather timing matters even more. A contractor should be able to explain whether the site can be stabilized during wet conditions and how they handle moisture-sensitive compaction work. The safest choice is usually the one that avoids rushed backfill during storms.
acceptedAnswer.description: Pool removal can be done year-round in Los Angeles, but wet weather can slow excavation, hauling, and compaction. Dry conditions are easier for grading and soil stability, while rain can delay inspections and make fill harder to compact properly.
